always-yes.label: Always YES (fixed 5 tier-1 flags)
always-yes.rule: serious_concern YES for every case; flags = the 5 tier-1 conditions with the most R10 targets in the 470 key (ties: more R5 targets, then name), as canonical codes: I47.1 (PSVT), I21 (Possible NSTEMI / STEMI), C34 (Pulmonary neoplasm), I20.9 (Stable angina), I20.0 (Unstable angina)

dxa.rule: YES when a tier-1 condition has DXA p >= 10% and is not a red herring (undetermined kept); flags = the top 5 such by p; differential = DXA's top 5; p_serious = DXA mass on tier-1 conditions. At the key's own threshold, not a ceiling
